notes: שָׁבִים … לָלֶכֶת is divided as *again* on the finite verb and *go* on the infinitive; giving *go again* wholly to the infinitive would leave a written finite verb unrendered, and the לְ is unrepresented because no function word is written for it (rules 40, 52).
אֵינֶנּוּ takes *is not* headed on the negation (rule 50); the suffix is unrepresented because the ASV writes the subject once, by the noun *the sea* (rule 22).
שֶׁ takes *whither* and שָׁם takes *thither* — each written morpheme holds the word written for it. Margin 'Or, torrents' read and set aside (rule 38).
